answers.core_task: Know what Simba needs next — and log it in one tap.
answers.never_do_or_show: Never a verbose briefing — 'what to expect' is compact action items with countdown-style windows from actual + historical data. Never let unentered days influence trend math. Never invent data — unlogged days show as missing, not zero. Never touch the live app — design work in mockups only.
answers.non_technical_user: Ankit + his wife, checking on a phone, usually one-handed while with the dog. Ankit built the app; the household uses it.
answers.what_are_we_building: Redesign WagWise, the household dog-care PWA for Simba the Cavapoo, so the daily job — knowing what Simba needs next, and logging it in one tap — is obvious at a glance, with the 12 existing screens reorganized, not rebuilt.

internal.device_already_used: Phone first; tablet and desktop as well.
internal.replaces: Fridge note / whiteboard, memory ('who took him out last?'), phone notes, spreadsheets (739-row master CSV), the 28-day Gemini workflow, paper vet records.

roles.does: Logs events, checks trends, runs the vet audit, manages settings and household.
Logs events and checks what to expect right now.
roles.must_not_see: Owner-only settings: household membership management, Supabase setup, data-version rollback.

notes: Live app: https://apatel85.github.io/Dashboards/WagWise/ — PWA, vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, GitHub Pages. Current version v3.27.14 (Oct 17, 2026 quick-log fix; on-phone confirmation still pending).
12 screens: Cockpit HUD, Voice/text log, Timeline, Trends, Insights, Ask/audit, Knowledge viewer, Meds & vaccines, Vet report (print/PDF), Household sharing, Export, Setup & login.

Data: Supabase schema simba_telemetry (subjects, telemetry_events; v2 adds household_members, medications, med_logs, vaccinations, walks). RLS via is_household(); auth Google + email; offline localStorage fallback.

Standing rules: 'what to expect' = compact action items with countdown windows from actual + historical data, never verbose briefings; trends from entered data only; remind about missed days. No background push for a PWA by design — the Muse check-in is the backstop.
Mockup only — the live app is NEVER touched. The redesign is presentation-only: screens, navigation, density. Data model, engines, and all 12 screens stay.

Style is Ankit's pick from the three options in the Receipt (soft rounded warm / clean clinical / playful illustrated); if he says 'you pick', build soft rounded, warm. Mock B baseline applies (three-role type, pill system, collapsed-by-default, breakpoint-gated layout).
source: App Sprints chat — built from known facts (no intake form submitted; Ankit asked to test the redesign on WagWise)
